slots.notes: Display serif used for both the center rotating words (italic) and the bottom-right 000->100 counter (upright, tabular-nums). Native value is the Google Font 'Instrument Serif' at weight 400; the words render in its italic style while the counter renders upright, so a substitute must offer both an italic and an upright cut and must support tabular figures so the zero-padded 3-digit counter does not shift width as it ticks.

mechanic: A fixed fullscreen loader on a near-black field plays a fixed-duration intro: three serif-italic words swap in the center every 900ms while a bottom-right counter rAF-counts 000->100 over 2.7s and a bottom-edge gradient progress bar scales its origin-left fill to match, then after a 400ms hold the whole overlay fades out (opacity, 0.6s) to reveal the page beneath.
techDelivery: Next.js 14 + TypeScript React component spec using Framer Motion (motion.div / AnimatePresence mode="wait") plus Tailwind utility classes; no asset pipeline, counter and progress are driven by requestAnimationFrame and setInterval in component state.
reskinNotes: Purely typographic + motion template with no brand image/video/icon/SVG sockets, so reskinning is mostly tokens and copy. Caveats: the progress-bar fill color is a hardcoded inline linear-gradient(90deg, #89AACC 0%, #4E85BF 100%) with a matching boxShadow glow rgba(137,170,204,0.35), so retinting the bar means editing the inline style string rather than the CSS variables (the gradient/glow are not wired to --tokens). Foreground text uses opacity-modified tokens (text-text/80 on the words), and the eyebrow plus the three rotating words ('Portfolio', 'Design'/'Create'/'Inspire') are hardcoded in markup. The choreography is hand-timed (900ms word swaps, 2.7s count, 400ms hold) and the counter is zero-padded to exactly 3 digits via padStart(3,'0'), so it assumes a 0-100 range and tabular figures; the rotating-words AnimatePresence is keyed by word index and stops at the last word without looping.
